country_scope_note: Institutional location, not faculty citizenship. CN means mainland China for this pilot.
snapshot_scope: Current publicly visible faculty directory, retaining its own source as-of date where stated; not a complete historical roster and not a 2025 professor membership freeze.
future_appointments: Preserve explicitly future appointments but do not sample them as current faculty.

sampling.pool: Recognized academic faculty categories from captured directory rows; no birth-year or DOB-availability filtering before sampling.
sampling.missing_directory: Keep blocked/partial status, do not replace the institution or department to fill the quota.

birth_year_treatment: Use explicitly stated birth year only. Unknown remains unknown. Keep out-of-window people in pilot to measure age eligibility; exclude only in a later documented analysis population.
era_matching: The common min/max window is a support rule, not completed age/era matching to academy or Nobel distributions.
dob_policy: Collect explicit birth claims and provenance. Preserve year/month/day precision and calendar labels; do not infer from age, graduation, anniversary or field defaults. Body-observed claims and search snippets remain distinct. Day availability is not formal accepted Gregorian DOB.
higher_tier_overlap: Retain professor affiliations; flag observed/available-reference academy or Nobel overlap separately. Unchecked is not a negative match. No final professor-only analysis cohort is created in this feasibility pass.
source_storage: Public outputs contain directory facts, source URLs, short claim excerpts, retrieval diagnostics and hashes. No full HTML/PDF/CV or private contacts/family data in public Git.
